dag_update.py.description: Safely update the Hypothesis DAG with a cross-platform file lock.

--hypothesis.description: Description of the new hypothesis (Required if action=add).

--metric.description: The evaluation metric. Must align with DAG primary metric (Optional).

--node-id.description: Node ID to update (Required if action=update).

--adoption.description: Adoption state: is the finding live? Required if action=adopt.

--artefact.description: Path or symbol in the running system that would carry this finding (Optional).

--verification.description: Shell predicate that exits 0 while the claim still holds (Optional, but required for adopted/partial/contradicted to count as verified).

--adoption-note.description: Why the node sits at this adoption state (Optional).

start-hypothesis.description: Design the scope and plan for a hypothesis node (Experimental Design).

progress-hypothesis.description: Activate or continue execution of a framed research item (Experimental Execution).

--wi-id.description: AAW Work Item ID e.g., WI-042

--clean-room.description: Enforce Clean Room verification against main branch to prevent worker bias.

reconcile.py.description: Reconcile the hypothesis DAG against the running system. Reports the gap, proposes nothing.

--cwd.description: Working directory adoption predicates run in.

--migrate.description: Seed a default adoption block on nodes that lack one, then exit.

--strict.description: Also fail when a node claims adoption without a predicate.
